text:
maya: Quick sync — postlaunch triage for 2.8.0. We ran through the board: 48 issues total, 6 P1s, 1 customer blocker (Acme) on streaming responses. Need to decide: hotfix for the blocker vs. batch polish in next micro-release. I sketched a two-lane plan below. Link to board: https://redwood/board/2.8.0 (please open)
Tom: Agree on two lanes. Acme blocker is P0 for us. Recommend hotfix patch (2.8.0.1) for P0 + safety P1s that affect infra/latency. Rest -> 2.8.1. @maya can we get a rollback plan if the patch causes perf regressions? :thinking_face:
maya: Yup — rollback plan in next message. Also need owners for each P1. I'll propose assignees after we hear infra/qa.
Ashley: I can own QA for the hotfix. Repro steps confirmed on staging; intermittent when request size > 8k tokens. Adding logs to the ticket and attaching repro gist.
oliver: UI polish items are mostly P3/P4. Move them to backlog grooming. If anyone wants a quick spike, I can bundle 3 items into a tiny design pass next week.
jessica: CS flag: Acme says this is impacting a single workflow but they will escalate to their security team if not addressed by Wed next week. They asked for an ETA window. We should give something conservative.
sre-bot: Deploy bot: Current canary capacity healthy (avg p99 210ms). Noted: node group cg-3 at 70% memory.
Tom: For rollback: if p99 increases > +50ms or error rate > 0.5% in canary, we revert. Need infra support for faster image rollouts. @sre on call?
maya: Draft two-lane plan (proposal):

```
Urgent lane (2.8.0.1 - hotfix):
- Includes: Acme P0 (streaming header fallback), P1 latency regressions x2 (txn routing + cache invalidation)
- Owner: tom (eng lead)
- QA: ashley
- Target: ship canary Tue AM, full rollout Wed AM
- Rollback triggers: p99 +50ms, error_rate >0.5%

Backlog lane (2.8.1):
- Includes: UI polish, UX copy, non-blocking enhancements, P2s
- Owner: oliver (design) + maya (product)
- Target: sprint after hotfix, milestone date: +3 weeks
```

maya: Acceptance criteria for hotfix (short):
- Reprocase fixed in staging
- E2E smoke + perf check within thresholds
- Customer repro validated by CS on staging
- Post-deploy telemetry dashboards ready

Tom: Sounds good. I'll own the hotfix branch and coord with infra for the canary ramp. Will post a CI build when ready.

Ashley: I'll run the repro matrix and attach flaky run logs. If we see any regression during canary, we halt and notify.

jessica: I'll coordinate with Acme and give them a conservative ETA window (Wed-Fri next week). Tell me when staging is ready for customer validation.

oliver: Moving polish items to grooming board now. If anyone thinks something should be upgraded to P1, ping me.

maya: Two quick asks before we close: 1) Tom, drop the hotfix PR link here when created. 2) SRE, please pre-allocate a small extra canary pool so we can ramp faster if needed.

Tom: Will do. PR -> https://redwood/repo/pulls/482 (draft)

sre-bot: Deploy bot: Canary pool preallocation requested by tom. Queue position 2. Estimated provisioning 18m.

maya: Great — thanks all. I'll update the board and send a short status update to execs after canary starts. :thumbsup:

jessica: Thanks — I'll line up Acme validation once PR is in staging.

Tom: ETA on canary build ~2h. Will update thread.

Ashley: Starting QA run now. Will share results in ~3h.

maya: Closing for now — we'll reconvene if any canary alarms fire. Otherwise, sync in tomorrow standup for roll forward plan.
